notes.title: New Game Mode: Climb the Mountain
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody!

We have added a [b]brand new Game Mode: Climb the Mountain![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In this game mode you have to climb the mountain as fast as you can. There is a beautiful princess waiting for you at the top of the mountain. So grab your buddies and race your way up![/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/014bcc39de71eb0108740a1bc780e3181f2e83c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also cool news! LIRIK played our game on Twitch live in front of 15k viewers![/p][p][url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2491191334?t=03h41m46s"]https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2491191334?t=03h41m46s[/url]
[/p][p]
Alrighty guys,[/p][p]See you in the next one![/p]

notes.title: Minor outfit update
notes.content: The adams leaf nude buttcrack is now covered up with a leaf as well making it Streamer and Content creator proof.

notes.title: New Game Mode: Free-For-All Update and More
notes.content:
[p]Hello Gorilla fighters,[/p][p][/p][p]The first update is here and we added some sweet new content! But first of all, I'd like to thank all of you who've played so far and the nice reviews you guys have written. Was a blast reading them and was honestly so fun seeing you guys playing the game so far![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/5b3a24684e90585dbc6a4bde4e06099c9f09fbd6.gif"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]In this update:[/b][/h3][p]
[b]Major addons:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New game mode:[/b] Free-for-all[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brand new Map:[/b] Free-for-all Arena1 (More maps coming!)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Minor addons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Sprinting to the Combat Man character (The one used in the game modes)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Lobby addons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a funny Vendor character to whom you can talk to purchase cosmetics.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Apparently there was an issue that the max session/server side was 16 players. Attempted to fix that so the game should actually support 100+ players per session now.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]More fun updates coming very very soon (This week)! Working on it day by day, my next aim is to have plenty more of the funny pre-made characters available for play this week! That will overall make the entire game have so much more content.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone and for any feedback please join the Discord link in the game on the main menu![/p][p][/p][p]OOGAAA BOOOOGAAA[/p][p][/p][p]We out!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/91994176d1b461e9b3d5fab3d537306398b95571.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/104ffb031984d6fe60cdb08b1b02fec10ee6fd78.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/7e87f2e85052cf9c005aaff33b45b23b5e8f99e7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/a0f2d0c7663e642e643dde3cda1721acdf26c3b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: "100 Men vs 1 Gorilla" is NOW LIVE in Early Access!

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Coming Tomorrow:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Two brand-new game modes will be added[/p][/*][*][p]New ways to play and even more ridiculous battles
